description: Average aCL IgG and ANA over all matched examination records within each sex. Each examination counts once.

a.request: For each patient sex (`Patient.SEX`), use every examination record that matches a patient (drop examinations with no matching patient), with each examination counting once even when a patient has several. Give the sex, the average `aCL IgG`, the average `ANA`, and that sex's average ANA divided by the mean of the per-sex average ANA values. Ignore missing values in all averages and don't round.
a.sql: WITH sex_stats AS (SELECT p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) as avg_aCL_IgG, AVG(e.ANA) as avg_ANA FROM Examination e INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ANA) as mean_avg_ANA FROM sex_stats) SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_aCL_IgG, s.avg_ANA, s.avg_ANA / o.mean_avg_ANA as ana_ratio FROM sex_stats s CROSS JOIN overall_mean o

d.request: For each patient sex, compute the mean aCL IgG and mean ANA across all examinations with non-null values, then express each sex's mean ANA as a ratio to the mean of those two per-sex ANA averages.
d.sql:
WITH sex_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.SEX,
        AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) as mean_aCL_IgG,
        AVG(e.ANA) as mean_ANA
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
    GROUP BY p.SEX
)
SELECT 
    SEX,
    mean_aCL_IgG,
    mean_ANA,
    mean_ANA / (SELECT AVG(mean_ANA) FROM sex_stats) as ANA_ratio
FROM sex_stats

b.request: Calculate average aCL IgG and average ANA grouped by patient sex from examination records (each examination counted once), and express each sex's average ANA as a ratio of the mean of the per-sex ANA averages.
b.sql: SELECT p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) as avg_aCL_IgG, AVG(e.ANA) as avg_ANA, AVG(e.ANA) / (SELECT AVG(sex_avg_ANA) FROM (SELECT AVG(e2.ANA) as sex_avg_ANA FROM Examination e2 JOIN Patient p2 ON e2.ID = p2.ID GROUP BY p2.SEX) inner_query) as ANA_ratio FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX
b.raw: Calculate average aCL IgG and average ANA grouped by patient sex from examination records (each examination counted once), and express each sex's average ANA as a ratio of the mean of the per-sex ANA averages.

c.request: By patient sex, what are the average aCL IgG and ANA values in the examination data (only examinations linked to a patient, missing values ignored)? Also give each sex's average ANA as a ratio of the mean of the per-sex ANA averages, unrounded. Average aCL IgG and ANA over all matched examination records within each sex. Each examination counts once.
c.sql:
WITH sex_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    p.SEX,
    AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) as avg_acl_igg,
    AVG(e.ANA) as avg_ana
  FROM Examination e
  JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY p.SEX
),
ana_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ana) as mean_ana
  FROM sex_averages
)
SELECT 
  s.SEX,
  s.avg_acl_igg,
  s.avg_ana,
  s.avg_ana / m.mean_ana as ana_ratio
FROM sex_averages s
CROSS JOIN ana_mean m
ORDER BY s.SEX;
